text: You plugged fucking Claude into your WhatsApp, right?
style: Cheeky and mocking, quick, like a best friend about to roast you.

text: All Sunday, bro. GitHub, QR code, config file. AI answers my leads now.
style: Proud and hyped, showing off his weekend project to his buddy, a casual American guy.

text: Cool. Who's answering them right now?
style: Flat and deadpan, a trap question.
Smug and casual, like it's obvious.

text: Claude's on your laptop. At home. Closed.
style: Dry and slow, one short beat per sentence, killing his vibe.

text: Wait, it doesn't reply by itself?
style: Confused, the confidence cracking, voice going up at the end.

text: Only when you open it and ask. That's not a setter, that's an intern.
style: A mocking roast, slow and smug, savoring the last word.

text: Fine, I'll bring the laptop to the gym.
style: Annoyed and stubborn, brushing it off.

text: Bring WhatsApp's terms too. No auto-messaging, or they can suspend your account.
style: Sly and calm, a little warning with a smirk. Start clearly on the word 'Bring', echoing his line about bringing the laptop.

text: Holy shit, my whole business is on that number.
style: Real panic rising, fast, voice going up at the end.

text: Also, it reads every chat. Your clients, your mom, your ex.
style: Teasing and mocking, a beat before each item, the last one savored.

text: Bro, I'm not a developer. I just want my DMs handled.
style: Deflated and tired, venting to a friend.

text: Then plug me into ManyChat. The official WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, no code.
style: Smooth and confident, a sly little offer, listing it easily.

text: And you answer while I'm training?
On my own, in your voice. And if I don't know, I hand it to you.
style: Calm and confident, a hint of smugness, a short beat between the two sentences.

text: Okay. How do I set you up?
style: Hesitant and a bit sheepish, a small pause after okay.

text: Finish your set first, you've been on that bench ten minutes.
style: Mocking, laughing at him, slow and smug.

text: Comment SETTY and I'll send you everything to build your AI setter for free.
style: Smooth and smug, then warm and generous on the offer, like handing over a gift.
